text.zh-CN: 石凿的帕塔莱什瓦尔石窟寺可追溯至8世纪。

kept.excerpt: the 8th century rock-cut Pataleshwar Caves temple

text.en: Shaniwar Wada dates to the 18th century.
text.zh-CN: 沙尼瓦尔瓦达可追溯至18世纪。

kept.excerpt: the 18th century Shaniwar Wada

text.en: Aga Khan Palace dates to the 19th century.
text.zh-CN: 阿伽汗宫可追溯至19世纪。

kept.excerpt: the 19th century Aga Khan Palace

value.text: Shinde Chhatri in Wanowrie is a memorial dedicated to the Maratha general Mahadaji Shinde.

text.en: Shinde Chhatri in Wanowrie is a memorial dedicated to the Maratha general Mahadaji Shinde.
text.zh-CN: 位于瓦诺夫里的辛德查特里是为马拉塔将军马哈达吉·辛德设立的纪念建筑。

kept.excerpt: Shinde Chhatri, located at Wanowrie, is a memorial dedicated to the Maratha general Mahadaji Shinde (Scindia).

value.text: Vishrambaug Wada is the last residential palace of the Peshwa and is being renovated by the city corporation.

text.en: Vishrambaug Wada is the last residential palace of the Peshwa and is being renovated by the city corporation.
text.zh-CN: 维什兰包格瓦达是佩什瓦最后一座住宅宫殿，目前正由市公司翻新。

kept.excerpt: A renowned wada in Pune is the last residential palace of the Peshwa called Vishrambaug Wada which is currently being renovated by the city corporation.

value.text: Pune is known for its British Raj bungalow architecture and the early-20th-century Garden Cities Movement layout of the Cantonment.

text.en: Pune is known for its British Raj bungalow architecture and the early-20th-century Garden Cities Movement layout of the Cantonment.
text.zh-CN: 浦那以英属印度时期的平房建筑以及军营区20世纪初的花园城市运动布局而闻名。

kept.excerpt: The city is also known for its British Raj bungalow architecture and the Garden Cities Movement layout of the Cantonment from the early 20th century.

value.text: Parks and green spaces in Pune include Kamala Nehru Park, Sambhaji Park, Shahu Udyan, Peshwe Park, Saras Baug, Empress Gardens and Bund Garden.

text.en: Parks and green spaces in Pune include Kamala Nehru Park, Sambhaji Park, Shahu Udyan, Peshwe Park, Saras Baug, Empress Gardens and Bund Garden.
text.zh-CN: 浦那的公园和绿地包括卡马拉·尼赫鲁公园、桑巴吉公园、沙胡乌迪亚、佩什韦公园、萨拉斯包格、皇后花园和 bund garden。

kept.excerpt: Parks and green spaces in the city include the Kamala Nehru Park, Sambhaji Park, Shahu Udyan, Peshwe Park, Saras Baug, Empress Gardens, and Bund Garden.

value.text: Hanuman hill, Vetal hill and Taljai Hills are protected nature reserves within Pune's city limits.

text.en: Hanuman hill, Vetal hill and Taljai Hills are protected nature reserves within Pune's city limits.
text.zh-CN: 哈奴曼山、韦塔尔山和塔尔贾伊山是浦那市界内的自然保护区。

kept.excerpt: The Hanuman hill, Vetal hill, and Taljai Hills are protected nature reserves on hills within the city limits.

value.text: The zoo formerly at Peshwe Park was merged with the reptile park at Katraj in 1999.

text.en: The zoo formerly at Peshwe Park was merged with the reptile park at Katraj in 1999.
text.zh-CN: 原位于佩什韦公园的动物园于1999年与卡特拉杰的爬行动物园合并。

kept.excerpt: The zoo, earlier located at Peshwe Park, was merged with the reptile park at Katraj in 1999.

text.en: Pune's riverfront development is situated along the banks of the Mula-Mutha River.
text.zh-CN: 浦那河滨开发项目位于穆拉－穆塔河沿岸。

kept.excerpt: Pune Riverfront is under-construction being developed by Pune Municipal Corporation along the banks of Mula-Mutha River.

value.text: The Pune Riverfront was under construction and was being developed by the Pune Municipal Corporation along the Mula-Mutha River.

text.en: The Pune Riverfront was under construction and was being developed by the Pune Municipal Corporation along the Mula-Mutha River.
text.zh-CN: 浦那河滨项目当时仍在建设，由浦那市政公司沿穆拉－穆塔河开发。

kept.excerpt: Pune Riverfront is under-construction being developed by Pune Municipal Corporation along the banks of Mula-Mutha River.

value.text: The Tilak Smarak Ranga Mandir, Bal Gandharva Ranga Mandir, Bharat Natya Mandir, Yashwantrao Chavan Natya Gruha and Sudarshan Rangmanch are prominent theatres in Pune.
value.zh-CN: 提拉克斯马拉克兰加曼迪尔、巴尔·甘达瓦·兰加曼迪尔、巴拉特纳蒂亚曼迪尔、亚希万特拉奥·查万纳蒂亚格鲁哈和苏达尚朗曼奇是浦那著名的剧院。

text.en: The Tilak Smarak Ranga Mandir, Bal Gandharva Ranga Mandir, Bharat Natya Mandir, Yashwantrao Chavan Natya Gruha and Sudarshan Rangmanch are prominent theatres in Pune.
text.zh-CN: 提拉克斯马拉克兰加曼迪尔、巴尔·甘达瓦·兰加曼迪尔、巴拉特纳蒂亚曼迪尔、亚希万特拉奥·查万纳蒂亚格鲁哈和苏达尚朗曼奇是浦那著名的剧院。

kept.excerpt: The Tilak Smarak Ranga Mandir, Bal Gandharva Ranga Mandir, Bharat Natya Mandir, Yashwantrao Chavan Natya Gruha, and Sudarshan Rangmanch are prominent theatres in the city.

value.text: Ganesh Kala Krida Rangamanch is the largest indoor theatre in Pune and has a seating capacity of approximately 45,000.

text.en: Ganesh Kala Krida Rangamanch is the largest indoor theatre in Pune and has a seating capacity of approximately 45,000.
text.zh-CN: 甘内什卡拉克里达兰加曼奇是浦那最大的室内剧院，座席容量约为45,000。

kept.excerpt: Ganesh Kala Krida Rangamanch is the largest indoor theatre in the city, with a seating capacity of approximately 45,000.

value.text: The Sawai Gandharva Sangeet Mahotsav is held in Pune every year in December.

text.en: The Sawai Gandharva Sangeet Mahotsav is held in Pune every year in December.
text.zh-CN: 萨瓦伊·甘达瓦音乐节每年12月在浦那举行。

kept.excerpt: The Sawai Gandharva Sangeet Mahotsav, one of the most prominent and sought-after Indian classical music festivals in India, is held in Pune every year in December.

value.text: The concept of Diwāḷī Pahāṭ originated in Pune as a music festival on the morning of Diwali.

text.en: The concept of Diwāḷī Pahāṭ originated in Pune as a music festival on the morning of Diwali.
text.zh-CN: “排灯节清晨”这一音乐节概念起源于浦那。

kept.excerpt: The concept of Diwāḷī Pahāṭ (lit. Diwali dawn) originated in Pune as a music festival on the morning of the festival of Diwali.

value.text: More than 150 Dhol-Tasha pathak groups operate in and around Pune.

text.en: More than 150 Dhol-Tasha pathak groups operate in and around Pune.
text.zh-CN: 浦那及其周边运营着150多个鼓乐团。

kept.excerpt: with there being over 150 such groups operating in and around Pune.

value.text: The main cuisine of Pune is Maharashtrian cuisine.

text.en: The main cuisine of Pune is Maharashtrian cuisine.
text.zh-CN: 浦那的主要菜系是马哈拉施特拉菜。

kept.excerpt: The main cuisine of Pune is Maharashtrian cuisine.

value.text: Bakarwadi is a popular snack from Pune that was introduced in the early 1960s.

text.en: Bakarwadi is a popular snack from Pune that was introduced in the early 1960s.
text.zh-CN: Bakarwadi是浦那一种流行小吃，始于20世纪60年代初。

kept.excerpt: Bakarwadi is a popular snack from Pune introduced in the early 1960s.

value.text: Pune International Airport is operated by the Airports Authority of India.

text.en: Pune International Airport is operated by the Airports Authority of India.
text.zh-CN: 浦那国际机场由印度机场管理局运营。

kept.excerpt: The airport is operated by the Airports Authority of India.

value.text: Pune International Airport ranked third best in the 5–15 million passenger category by Airport Service Quality in 2018.

text.en: Pune International Airport ranked third best in the 5–15 million passenger category by Airport Service Quality in 2018.
text.zh-CN: 2018年，浦那国际机场在年客流量500万至1,500万人类别中获机场服务质量第三名。

kept.excerpt: Pune International Airport at Lohegaon was ranked third best in the category of 5–15 million passengers by Airport Service Quality in 2018.
